en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a small historic Lutheran church. The photo shows wooden pews, an ornate altar with a crucifix and statues, chandeliers hanging from the ceiling, a tall Swedish longcase clock, and a wooden pulpit with painted panels. A hymn board with numbers stands to the left. At the bottom edge there is a printed caption identifying the church and a photographer/publisher credit.
